name: @helpdesk/agent
description: Two agents, one file each: identity-agent.ts and mdm-agent.ts. Agent SDK wrappers, zero built-in tools, each allowing only its own gateway's tools, each holding its own certificate scoped to that gateway's audience (SPRINT2.md, Stage B) and no Graph permission. The one runtime import either takes from @helpdesk/identity-gateway is CertificateCredential; everything else is a type definition or the shared @helpdesk/audit-core package.
